messages.text:
I turned on reduced motion on my computer, but the cards and the win banner still animate. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Fixed reduced motion for the card border transition and victory banner. They now become static when reduced motion is enabled, including when the preference changes while the game is open. Normal motion remains unchanged.

The build, all 138 unit and static tests, and all three motion browser tests passed. The full browser suite passed 75 of 77 checks; the face-art and saved-score checks timed out at 30 seconds, including on individual retries. The repository-wide formatting check also flagged 23 unrelated files; the changed files pass formatting.
